title: Goofy Ahh Car Horn
blurb: A horn that has no business sounding like this. Where an ordinary car horn communicates warning, this one communicates circus — and applying it to any arrival or departure instantly reclassifies the driver as a clown, without a word being said. Play it when somebody turns up forty minutes late holding an iced coffee they stopped for, or when a person leaves the group chat immediately after starting an argument in it. Beep beep, but disrespectfully, and with the full weight of the goofy ahh tradition behind it.
origin: From the goofy ahh meme genre — vehicle horns included.
